configOptions.name: Mode
configOptions.description: Controls how Copilot responds: a conversational agent, planning multi-step work, or autonomous autopilot.

options.name: Agent
options.description: Default agent mode for conversational interactions

options.name: Plan
options.description: Plan mode for creating and executing multi-step plans

options.name: Autopilot
options.description: Autonomous mode that enables allow-all and runs until task completion without user interaction (experimental)

configOptions.name: Model
configOptions.description: The AI model Copilot uses to generate responses.

options.name: Auto
options.description: Let Copilot pick the best model

configOptions.name: Reasoning Effort
configOptions.description: How much reasoning the model performs before responding. Higher effort can improve quality at the cost of speed.

options.name: xhigh
options.description: Extensive reasoning for the hardest problems.

options.name: max
options.description: Maximum reasoning; slowest but most thorough.

configOptions.name: Allow All
configOptions.description: Controls whether Copilot prompts for approval before using tools, accessing paths, or fetching URLs.

options.name: On
options.description: Automatically approve all tool, path, and URL requests

options.name: Off
options.description: Require approval for tool, path, and URL requests
